description: Hydrophilic Polyurethane Injection Resin is a single-component, low-viscosity, hydrophilic, water-reactive injection resin.
whereToUse: For the sealing of leakage in residential and commercial buildings
underground tunnels, subway tunnels, highway tunnels
water conservancy and hydropower projects, mining projects
for improving the impermeability of the soil surface layer
advantages: Low viscosity, good injectability, and excellent adhesion to the substrate.
Can absorb up to 10 times of water to form flexible gel rapidly when in contact with water.
Can be used at damp or running water conditions
Can be used in underwater application
Cured resin is inert and chemically-resistant
Cured resin can expand upon contact with water, suitable for the water leakage of movement joints.

technicalData.label: Shelf life
technicalData.value: 9 months from the date of production

storage: The storage temperature should not exceed 40°C.
